sections.title: Remove per-user ownership check from API key deletion and move auth to route dependency
sections.rationale: All three hunks together drop the user_id ownership check from the delete_api_key CRUD function and its two callers, replacing the route's CurrentActiveUser parameter with a bare get_current_active_user dependency so any authenticated user can delete any API key by id.
